name: GORAL

prices.note: Base feed is GBP (£305–£415). US prices read from each product's .js with the store's own US setting (?country=US, Shopify.currency USD): 23 regular-price boots, $422 (Birley Barefoot Chelsea) to $575 (Tuggs Rose Anvil pull-on, pre-order); Sharman Boot Horween Black $490; Baslow Chelsea Boot from £340.

notes: US shipping: free over $400, $20 below; all import duties, taxes and customs prepaid since 1 September 2025 (https://www.goral-shoes.co.uk/policies/shipping-policy).
Returns: register within 14 days of receiving, unworn in original packaging; custom orders non-refundable; pre-orders exchange only (https://www.goral-shoes.co.uk/policies/refund-policy).
Heritage: family workshop in Poland in 1936, moved to Sheffield in 2005; Made in England (https://www.goral-shoes.co.uk/pages/our-heritage).
Sharman sizes UK6/US7 to UK13/US14, men's only (https://www.goral-shoes.co.uk/collections/boots/products.json).
